ذكر المستغفريّ عن البخاريّ- أنه ذكرها فيمن روى عن النبي ﵌ من نساء بني هاشم. وجوّز أبو موسى أن تكون هي أم الفضل زوج العباس الماضية.

segments.english:
12206 — Umm al-Fadl bint al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib al-Hashimiyya. (2)

Al-Mustaghfiri reported from al-Bukhari that he mentioned her among the women of Banu Hashim who narrated from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). Abu Musa considered it possible that she was the previously discussed Umm al-Fadl, the wife of al-Abbas.

THE SECOND AND THIRD SECTIONS

Both are empty.
